svg.title: British Columbia / Park Ranger — 1229
svg.desc: Clean designed reconstruction of the photographed badge. Smooth geometry and outlined type replace all image-derived contours. Relief, hammered grain, ageing, reflections and display stands are omitted. Exact original typeface, die engraving and material tones cannot be authenticated; the few silver/bronze fills are a material interpretation. The shared numbered Park Ranger template retains the serial, broad silhouette profile and full versus simplified armorial distinction. Lower edges hidden by display stands are completed from the matching family outline. The modern full achievement uses the exact uploaded native BC arms, uniformly fitted with its original geometry and stroke semantics. Two-tone engraved paint is a metal interpretation of that artwork, not authenticated die engraving.
